script.source: ability/hacker/health.py RejuvenateRSI_DirectObject resuscitates the recipient, fills current HP and IS maxima, plays FX_CHARACTER_RESTORE_RSI and Stand/Action_Resurrect with context 416, sends separate caster and recipient results, then applies flag-only 1208 to the caster if the recipient is PvP-flagged.
script.runtime: The normal 81 88 approval dispatch reaches AbilityResurrection.Reply after a matching offer. RestoreVitals preserves Death Effect and the recipient's flag. Present publishes the self vitals, built-in stand, effect and both replies before the conditional caster flag.
script.test: RejuvenateNativeReplyRunsTheScriptCallbackOnlyAfterConsent verifies the offer, accepted and declined native-shaped replies, duplicate approval handling, both result messages, live vitals plus the 416 stand, restore FX, and the conditional caster flag. PR696 separately witnessed the shared 1208 callback on a flagged stock Restore 325 recipient. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/696#issuecomment-7069292847

behavior-tests.source: GOB 416 stores 150 IS and a 15 s own reuse for the dead-friendly cast. Its authored callback reads live maxima and awaits recipient consent.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler admits and costs the normal corpse-targeted cast. AbilityResurrection's authenticated offer and consent paths publish the resources and stock movement. Rejuvenate uses its own context 416.

RejuvenateRestoresLiveMaximaAfterDeathEffectRecovery covers 605/1080, 610/1090 and 615/1090.
